formulas.description: How BPR detects issues from the process model and event log.

bottleneck.title: Bottleneck detection
bottleneck.description: Top 3 nodes by expected duration qualify if their time is at least 15% of total cycle time. Severity is set by the node's share of total cycle time.

reworkLoop.title: Rework loop
reworkLoop.description: Severity is driven by loop probability. Expected iterations follow the geometric-series mean for a loop with repeat probability r.

conformanceFitness.title: Conformance fitness
conformanceFitness.description: Each case is penalized by its violations relative to the expected path length; the overall score is the average across cases.

slaCompliance.title: SLA compliance
slaCompliance.description: Each event meets SLA when its duration is within the task benchmark. Compliance rolls up from events to tasks to the overall process.
